# Coverage matrix (generated by `scripts/build_legal_catalog.py`; do not edit)

Requirements are derived from the law alone (`legal_requirements.yaml`, quotes machine-checked against `sources/`); decisions compare them with the rulebook and with what `backend/f1/rules.py` really reads (`event_mapping.json`). Machine-checked quotes are not human-verified interpretations: `citation_status` stays as the rulebook says.
